subject: Where the owner-serviceable fluid fill points are in the engine bay, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Engine oil level".

mustShow.text: HERO: The cap on the translucent coolant expansion tank, with a filler neck marked MAX and MIN; reported on the passenger side toward the firewall.
The washer-fluid filler neck cap, reported black with a wiper symbol, serving window and headlamp washers.
The engine oil filler neck cap on top of the engine.
The brake fluid reservoir at the driver-side base of the windshield, hidden under a long plastic cover.

mustNotShow: coolant expansion tank cap detail (Exact tank shape; cap color and whether marks are on the tank side or filler neck conflict; depict a generic translucent tank)
brake reservoir under cover detail (The reservoir is hidden; do not show cover screw count or the reservoir's cap markings)
washer fluid filler cap detail (Side is supported (passenger) but exact position and cap colour (black vs blue) are not; show a filler on the passenger side without colour)
